string.text: Shows the TOTAL amount of ammo you have for each 3 types available in the inventory.
Shows the Armor Condition as a percentage in cyan text. \n%c[ui_gray_2]Has no effect if the bar is disabled.
Shows the amount of blood you're losing as a bar that is besides the Health bar, going from left-to-right.
Shows the amount of Health you are recovering as a 1-by-10 health signs, on top and bottom of the Bleeding Bar. \n\nRecommended to have the Bleed Bar enabled with this.
Makes the Old Ammo appear where relevant (Such as not having its "good" counterparts)
Shows the amount of Radiation you have as an icon that is besides the Stamina & Psy bars, going from bottom-to-top.
Makes the Weapon Condition Bar disappear when you unequip. \n%c[ui_gray_2]Has no effect if the bar is disabled.
Shows the Weapon Condition as a percentage in orange text. \n%c[ui_gray_2]Has no effect if the bar is disabled.
